classification.sisyphus: PROXY-DOMINATED with an evidence-disconnected failure mode (null stagnation renormalizes Match to 100% proxy)

rationale.newton: 22 of 35 Newton Match>=50 wallets have reentryCount=0 (no exit->re-entry pairs exist); for every completed==0 case the stored Match equals ACTIVITY exactly (see residuals)
rationale.sisyphus: 5 of 33 Sisyphus Match>=50 wallets have null progress efficiency, making their Match 100% activity/turnover/repetition; the rest carry a genuine 0.30-weight stagnation contribution

proposal.mechanism: replace renormalization-over-available-weights with division-by-declared-total-weight in weightedValue (missing core evidence contributes zero instead of redistributing its weight to proxies)
alternativesEvaluated: multiplicative evidence factor min(1, pricedPairs/2): equivalent effect for Newton but adds a new tunable constant
Match cap when core absent: same outcome, but a hard cap is less informative than the natural weighted form
weighted geometric mean: penalizes imbalance smoothly, but changes every persona's score surface — not minimal
proposal.rationale: smallest possible change; directly enforces 'core evidence constrains Match, not merely eligibility'; chosen for principle, not for coverage

counterfactual.name: declared-weight division (no renormalization credit for missing core evidence)
